decisions.reason: Because this waterproof lined safety shoe range is very close to the firm's core footwear capabilities, the firm's own R&D and materials know-how make it more likely to refine and retain it than to withdraw it, though overlap within a broad portfolio leaves some rationalisation risk.

This electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe builds directly on the firm's established protective-footwear knowledge and technical development base, so absorptive capacity is high and management would likely keep and improve it rather than drop it.

A new safety shoe series sits at the center of the firm's existing offer, and in a growing industry a German specialist with in-house R&D would usually continue such a core product family while learning from early market feedback.
